clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Mennet Carkad sends promising rogues after Fenwick Thatros on Lord Varimathras's orders. Thatros is suspected of organizing independent undead forces along Silverpine Forest's shores. Killing him proves an operative's mettle to the Deathstalkers and opens the way to advanced trade training.

In the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter, Mennet Carkad handles Deathstalker contracts and training. The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's secretive intelligence wing. Lord Varimathras has named Fenwick Thatros as a priority target, a charge too serious for novice recruits. Thatros has established a foothold among rogue undead in Silverpine Forest. If left alone, their independent leadership could threaten Forsaken control across Lordaeron's old holdings.

Deathstalker scouts report Fenwick Thatros near a decrepit dock on Lake Lordamere in Silverpine Forest. Reaching him means crossing wilderness claimed by feral beasts, Rot Hide gnolls, and Scourge remnants. Varimathras demands proof of the kill: Thatros's severed head. Bringing it back can earn an operative entry into deeper covert operations.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lord Varimathras has just sent me a missive about a threat to the Forsaken that must be immediately removed. His name is Fenwick Thatros, one whom Lord Varimathras believes is a leader of the undead that have taken root in Silverpine Forest.
Your name came to mind immediately, friend. I have faith enough in your abilities that you will carry out this mission flawlessly.
The latest reports from the Deathstalkers in Silverpine indicate that Thatros can be found near the decrepit dock on Lordamere.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have placed the utmost faith in you to perform this service for Lord Varimathras.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done well, friend. It occurs to me that you have performed many services for the Deathstalkers, proving your worth, and that perhaps it is time that we furthered your training in the shadow arts.
